comments.value: Had a few players reporting that exact issue in my world. For me it is a black screen ,after loading the wold, that goes away after a few seconds and Im good to go. Some people seem to get stuck in that black screen. I have no clue what unity does during that time. Shader stuff or decrompressing textures? Whatever it is it is not good...

@{58c6b3cc227a56787575ebb4|full_name}: the odd thing is it seems to happen in different worlds for different people, as I've seen people have the issue in worlds I can see perfectly fine in.
edit: and it also appears I do not have that issue in any of your worlds, too.

Same thing, it's random, tried Oculus and Steam installed (plus cache clearing and reinstalls). I can't get to Graffiti, sometimes, and sometimes I can't get to my own home without closing and restarting VRChat. There's two versions of the failure, one where the handheld menu is fully visible, and one where the black "overlay" blinding you is on top of the menu so you can barely see it with good eyesight and the right display.

@{5a69eccdd20e79665351e7c1|full_name}: I'm not sure that's the same bug though I've seen the one you're talking about now and then.

But the one I have is 100% consistent per-map, per-user; it doesn't "sometimes" happen for me on the affected maps, it always does.

Don't know if it involves an overlay, unless selecting triggers or grab-able objects show up above that, too.  I've run into being able to "barely see" a lot of worlds like that but on those cases I can eventually get into an instance of the world I can see in.  Usually on those I get booted to other instances, and it can happen on any world.

In this bug report's case I never can see in these worlds unless the world creator updates the world in a way that fixes it.  I don't know what causes or fixes it, but for example after a recent (latest?) update to one of the worlds above (Club VGL) I no longer have this issue in it.  With the other worlds (and more I've found) I still have the issue though.

I want to be VERY careful about not getting this confused with other black screen bugs even if they do turn out to be related.

This issue STILL persists.

Roughly 1/4 to 1/3 of the times I enter worlds I haven't been to I'm risking not being able to see in those worlds.  Ran into three worlds out of the ones I went into today alone, old and new, where I cannot see in them except for outlines of interactive objects when pointed at, and playspace bounds.  Attached are screenshots of what I am talking about.  I don't even know what the first item is.  Second item is a door which I could see move while pointing at it.

I cannot let this issue stay idle because every new or updated world I enter is practically russian roulette over whether I can see or not.

What am I supposed to do about this?  Because all that email support ever did in the end for this, after going through cache clears, VRC reinstalls, driver reinstalls, and copy-pasting to me the steps listed in the #vrchat-support channel in the discord server that led me to make the ticket in the first place, was to throw hands up in the air and give up.

details:
Version: many, since March or so and I don't remember which was the first version the issue started in.

Description: upon entering some worlds, everything seems to load, and I'm properly in a session, but absolutely everything is pure black except for any selection outlines for objects close to me, which appears to render perfectly.  I cannot see my menu, either.

What happens:
- I enter a world that causes this issue
- Downloading/Loading screen completes
- World loads and I can hear people and sounds, move around, even "use" my menu, but nothing renders (so I cannot see the menu to use it).
- I am never "kicked out" of the world nor put into a loading screen/loop.  I simply have a black screen with nothing rendering indefinitely or until I force-quit through steam VR (which I can see) or Alt+F4, etc.
- If I restart VRChat and either rejoin the instance I was in, or create a brand new instance, the above points happen.

- I've found out that specific worlds, not rooms/instances, appear to do this.
- This happens in both VR and Desktop modes.
- This is not the other black screen bug(s) which kick people out to other instances or cause loading loops. Plus when the "other" black screen bug(s) happen I can faintly make out parts of whatever world I'm in, but that does not happen here.
- I have found that if I can exit the world within the game (i.e. through menu->go home, being led into a portal, or being votekicked, etc.) I can see again as soon as the loading screen appears.
- Often, other people in the same world don't seem to be affected by this at all.
- I have seen some people have the same issue on the same maps I have this issue with, but I have also seen other people have this issue with separate maps.

Things I've tried:
- Load my own, private instance of a world that does this.
- Clear cache.
- Complete reinstall of graphics drivers.
- Email exchange with VRChat Support until finally being told it can't be reproduced and to post here.

Worlds I've had this issue in:
- Speed Dating: Valentine's Edition*
- Club VGL*
- Japari Cafe (night)
- The Hallwyl Museum
- Cafe Leblanc*
- Others I didn't get the name of from when I first started having the issue.  Back then I thought it was network issues.

Worlds marked with an asterisk are worlds I used to be able to see in.
title: Certain worlds have completely black screen, no rendering except selection outlines
